person.foaf:name: Sina K. Heshmati
person.foaf:title: Collibra Solution Architect · Data & AI Governance · Open Source Engineer

cv.profile:
Certified Collibra Solution Architect (Dec 2024) with 10+ years designing and deploying data governance platforms across enterprise and regulated-industry environments. Deep practitioner in semantic technologies — RDF, OWL, SPARQL, ontology modelling — and in the integration layer that connects governance platforms to real-world data flows (MuleSoft / Collibra Connect, Kafka, Java, Python). Founder of Lutino.io, building Singine: an open-source AI agent orchestrator for document ingestion, knowledge graph construction, and natural language querying over administrative data.
Beyond the screen: aspiring ranger with a commitment to stewarding open, real-world communities with the same rigour applied to data. Brings six languages, a background in logic and philosophy (VUB 2008–2012), and a twenty-year history of independent open-source contribution.

skill-group.skill: Ontology Design (RDF, OWL, SKOS, DCAT, PROV)

position.achievement: Advising on AI governance frameworks and data quality programmes for financial markets clients; applying Collibra DGC operating model principles to AI asset cataloguing and lineage tracking.
Bridging semantic ontology expertise (RDF, OWL, SKOS) with emerging AI regulation requirements (EU AI Act, DORA); translating compliance requirements into implementable metamodel extensions.
Designing MCP-based agent interfaces for governance workflow automation; integrating Collibra REST APIs with Python and Java orchestration layers.

Designed and delivered end-to-end Collibra implementations for regulated-industry clients: operating model definition, asset type taxonomy, domain structure, attribute model, and workflow orchestration.
Authored Collibra metamodels aligned to DCAT, PROV-O, and FIBO for financial and regulatory data catalogues; versioned via YAML schema registry with semantic diff tooling.

Led Collibra Connect (Mule ESB OEM) integration streams: flow authoring in Anypoint Studio, connector development, .jar deployment lifecycle, and migration planning to Collibra Marketplace Spring Boot templates.
Operated Collibra Edge deployments across distributed client environments; managed apps/ deployment directories and Mule runtime lifecycle.
Advised clients on the Keep-vs-Migrate decision framework for legacy Mule flows, reducing unnecessary rewrite spend. Built the Mule Runtime 4.10 CE fork for hosting legacy Collibra Connect flows.
Founded Plain Source; launched Lutino.io (subscription management platform, v1.055) and Singine (AI agent orchestrator for document processing and knowledge graph construction).
Architected Singine as a polyglot, multi-layer platform: Clojure core, Python CLI bridge, Node.js MCP gateway, GraphQL API; designed the Singine XML wire protocol and canonical namespace registry.
Built singine-mcp: an MCP stdio server exposing infrastructure and LinkedIn tools as typed MCP tools (Zod schemas, XML response parsing, idempotent revert tokens).
Shipped SilkPage (XML/XSLT publishing framework, MarkupWare v0.6.0) and open-source governance tooling including this live CV system.
Maintained the MarkupWare portfolio of open-source markup and programming language projects under the Khakbaz Foundation (est. 2001); twenty-year contributor to open standards communities.
Designed and published the datatech-wiki-kg knowledge graph supporting Wikipedia contributions on data technology topics.
Contributed to AI benchmarking, Emacs MCP explorer tooling, and the SinLisp runtime (Lisp dialect for singine workflow orchestration).

cv.personal: Mathematician by disposition, logician by training, writer by habit. Equal parts open-source contributor and community member — the overlap between "real-world communities" and distributed systems is not accidental. Aspiring ranger: drawn to environments that reward patience, situational awareness, and long-horizon stewardship — qualities that apply equally to old-growth forests and data governance programmes.
